parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the IDaaS EIAM instance.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: The browser origin in the format of scheme://host[:port]. This value cannot be modified after creation.

parameters.name: TrustOriginName
parameters.description: The name of the trusted origin used for management, display, and auditing. If not specified, the value is empty.

parameters.name: TrustedOriginScene
parameters.description: The trusted origin scenes. Only iframe_embed and cors are supported. At least one value is required.
